title: New 'Naruto' Manga 'Shadow Rising' Announced
content: The Naruto: What's Next? panel at New York Comic Con 2026 announced on Saturday that Masashi Kishimoto will launch a new Naruto manga titled Naruto: Shadow Rising , revealing a super teaser announcement video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Naruto x Ninkuu' Crossover Anime Announced
content: The "Naruto: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con 2026 announced a brand new four-episode crossover anime based on Masashi Kishimoto 's Naruto manga and Kouji Kiriyama 's Ninkuu manga on Saturday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Anime's 2nd Part Reveals January 2027 Debut in Video
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed in a new trailer on Sunday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of the third anime season based on ONE and Yūsuke Murata 's One Punch Man manga will debut in January 2027. Viz Media is streaming an English-subtitled version of the trailer.
author: ANN

title: Naruto Mobile Game to Get Worldwide Release; Naruto Card Game Reveals Demo, Release Dates
content: The "NARUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday that the Naruto Mobile game, currently only available in Mainland China, will get a worldwide release. More details will be revealed at the Jump Festa '27 event, which will take place on December 19-20.
author: ANN

title: Naruto to Officially Return With Brand-New Manga From Original Creator – Watch First Look Trailer
content: Naruto ‘s creator is officially returning to the series with a brand new manga, and the first look has been revealed at what to expect. Naruto has kicked off a new wave of projects that are being lined up for the next three years at least.
author: ComicBook

title: Masashi Kishimoto to Launch New Naruto Manga
content: The "NARUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday that Masashi Kishimoto will launch a new manga in his Naruto franchise. The below video teases a possible title: Shadow Rising Naruto (or Naruto Shadow Rising ).
author: ANN

title: Dr. Stone TV Anime Gets Terraforming Sequel
content: The "Stone Fes. 2026" event announced on Saturday that production has been green-lit on Dr. Stone Terraforming , a sequel to the television anime of Riichirou Inagaki and Boichi 's Dr. Stone manga . The new anime will adapt the "Terraforming" sequel story, set after the main story, from the 27th manga volume.
author: ANN

title: Naruto Gets Crossover Anime With Ninku Franchise
content: The "NA RUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday more information about the new television anime "limited" series teased last month. The new anime is a crossover anime with Koji Kiriyama 's Ninku ninja manga titled NARUTO ×NINKŪ.
author: ANN
